title: Squarespace API keys
snippet:
An application programming interface (API) lets developers build integrations and applications that can connect to your Squarespace site.

> The Squarespace API has the following availability. To learn more, visit [Choosing the right Squarespace plan](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206536797):
>
> - **Forms API (for Zapier integration)** is available on Core, Plus, Advanced, Business, Commerce Basic, and Commerce Advanced plans.
> - **Orders API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Inventory API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.
> - **Transactions API** is available in the Core, Plus, Advanced, and Commerce Advanced plan.

title: Developer Tools APIs at Squarespace
snippet:
The following is a list of Squarespace Developer Tools APIs. Squarespace will aim to keep this list up to date. Some of these Developer Tools are available for use by all developers, and some are invite-only. Use of our Developer Tools and participation in any Squarespace developer programs are subject to the [Squarespace Developer Terms](http://squarespace.com/developer-terms).
Each API contains multiple endpoints. Please see the applicable API documentation (e.g., [Reseller](http://reseller.squarespace.com), [Websites](http://developers.squarespace.com), [Acuity](http://developers.acuityscheduling.com)) for more details. If you have any questions, please [contact us](https://www.squarespace.com/contact).

title: Squarespace Pricing & API Plans | APIs.io
snippet:
Squarespace Plans Pricing is the pricing profile for [Squarespace](https://apis.io/providers/squarespace/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network — every figure transcribed verbatim from the provider’s own pricing page on 2026-10-28.
It defines 4 plans, including *Basic* — $25 /mo; *Core* — $39 /mo; *Plus* — $65 /mo, and 1 more.
The page prices the business product the API comes with, not the API alone, as a tiered subscription; the service is delivered as managed.

Compare tiers
| Plan | Price | Includes | Overage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $25 /mo per site | 2 contributors, AI credits 10 (one-time), 2% online store transaction fee, card rates from 2.9% + $0.30; annual price $19 /mo | — |
| Core | $39 /mo per site | Unlimited contributors, AI credits 20 / mo, no online store transaction fees, card rates from 2.9% + $0.30; annual price $29 /mo | — |
| Plus | $65 /mo per site | AI credits 40 / mo, card rates from 2.7% + $0.30; annual price $49 /mo | — |
| Advanced | $139 /mo per site | AI credits 120 / mo, card rates from 2.5% + $0.30, high-traffic checkout; annual price $99 /mo | — |

title: Developer Tools
snippet:
> Some Developer Tools options, including developer mode and Amazon integrations are available only in Core, Plus, Advanced, Business, Commerce Basic, and Commerce Advanced plans.

| **Developer API Keys** | Use developer API keys to build integrations with other software. To learn more, visit [Squarespace API Keys](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/236297987). The Squarespace API is a premium feature: - **Forms API** (for Zapier integration) is available on Business and Commerce plans. - **Orders API** is available in the Commerce Advanced plan.

| **Developer mode (**[**version 7.0**](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/115005308187)** only)** | Enable developer mode to build a custom template using custom code. To learn more about the Developer Platform, visit our [developer documentation](http://developers.squarespace.com). Developer mode is a [premium feature](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/115015517328).

title: Squarespace Developer Platform: APIs, Apps, and Docs
snippet: With [Squarespace's Commerce Advanced](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing) plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.

title: Selling on the Basic, Core, Plus, and Advanced plans
snippet:
​​For current pricing and a full comparison of these plans, visit our [pricing page](http://squarespace.com/pricing). Keep in mind the following:
- All website plans are available in annual or monthly billing cycles. On an annual billing cycle, the average monthly cost is lower, and you can register a [free custom domain](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206541787) for a year.
- Domain pricing [varies by TLD](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/206541907).
- You can review tax amounts at checkout. To learn more, visit [US sales tax and Squarespace billing](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/articles/227535647).
